author: blu
body: This unit is a rewrite, but it is registered as the opt-in `simplify` pass and is NOT in `default-ir-pipeline`. The shipping compiler's own compilation does not run it, so the default output is byte-identical and the fixed point is undisturbed; it is exercised by `-Passes simplify` and scored by the ablation harness. It absorbs the rules of the hardcoded `fold-constants` pass but does not yet replace it -- that swap is a codegen change to the default pipeline and its own CL.

author: blu
body: A binary node whose operands are already simplified. When both are the right kind of literal a fold may fire; otherwise the node is rebuilt unchanged. Character equality compares code points; character ordering is left to a later slice.

author: blu
body: An act statement's bind is in scope for the statements after it, so its name is removed from the substitution before the tail is walked -- the same do-notation scoping the occurrence analyser and the emitter follow. The bind's own value is simplified under the substitution as it stands, because the value is evaluated in the scope before the bind.

author: blu
body: A definition is simplified by iterating one traversal of its body until a traversal reports no rewrites or the cap is reached. The substitution starts empty at the definition boundary -- a parameter is not a literal, so nothing propagates in from the signature.
